name: Morenatsu.
source:
The game takes place during summer vacation. The main character, Hiroyuki Nishimura gets a letter from a friend in the village he spent his childhood in. He moved away to the city 5 years ago. His grandparents currently live there, so he decides to return there.

At the bus stop in the village, he is greeted by a tiger named Torahiko, who was one of his childhood friends. They are excited to see each other again. Torahiko tells Hiroyuki that later there will be a welcome back party for him at a restaurant. He then directs Hiroyuki to his grandparents' house and tells him where the restaurant where the party will be at is.

Later, he goes to the restaurant where the party is. He's greeted by all his other childhood friends: Tatsuki the dragon, Kounosuke the Tanuki, Kouya the husky, Juuichi the bear, Shin the cat, Shun the wolf, and Kyouji the dog. Kyouji introduces Hiroyuki to Soutarou, a lion that moved to the village 3 years ago. Then the food is served, and the player must choose who Hiroyuki will sit with. (8 options available, even though there are 9 characters, the reason is one of the options is sitting with Kyouji and Soutarou.) After eating, the group unanimously shouts "Welcome home Hiroyuki!" 

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikifur.com/wiki/Morenatsu]Wikifur[/url]]
translation:
游戏舞台是暑假。主人公西村博行收到一封来自儿时居住村庄朋友的信。五年前，他搬到城市；祖父母仍住在村里，于是他决定回去。

在村里的巴士站，他受到儿时好友、老虎大岛虎彦迎接。两人都很高兴重逢。虎彦告诉博行，稍后会在餐馆为他举行欢迎归来派对，接着指引他前往祖父母家，也告诉他派对餐馆的位置。

后来，他来到餐馆，其他儿时好友都在那里迎接：龙翠屋辰树、狸猫九狸孝之助、哈士奇苍月洸哉、熊三日月柔一、猫黑井深、狼古酉峻，以及狗高原京慈。京慈又把三年前搬来村子的狮子橙野宗太郎介绍给博行。食物端上来后，玩家必须选择博行与谁同坐。可选项有八个，尽管角色有九人，因为其中一个选项是与京慈和宗太郎同坐。用餐后，大家异口同声地喊道：“欢迎回家，博行！”
